scope: canonical V25 reduced-ChaCha inversion/exponent research only; not an impossibility proof for all cryptanalysis
alpha_pass_rule: ALPHA_PASS requires explicit TOTAL work including preprocessing/data/memory/verification of form 2^(alpha*b+o(b)) with alpha<1, or a preregistered empirical alpha gate whose upper confidence bound is below the project threshold. Constant factors, memory-only compression, statistical signal, rank improvement without total scaling, and reduced candidate-evaluation cost with 2^b enumeration do not qualify.
supersession_rule: A historical CONTINUE/NEXT label is not UNRESOLVED if a later canonical milestone executed that next gate and closed or classified it.
closure_gate: Close V25_CURRENT_EXPONENT_TRACK if ALPHA_PASS count is zero and every historical CONTINUE/NEXT item is either superseded by a later closed milestone or classified METHOD_PASS_ONLY/CONSTANT_FACTOR_PASS with no admitted exponent path. Closure means no alpha<1 demonstrated in tested V25 families; it does not claim mathematical impossibility of future mechanisms.
post_closure: Preserve useful engineering primitives (constant-factor boundary screen, layout codegen, exact puncturing/trail and D&C/CERT90 machinery) separately. Any genuinely new exponent hypothesis opens as a new V26 preregistered mechanism rather than silently extending V25.
forbidden: No reclassifying constant-factor gains as alpha passes; no creating a new family inside the closure audit; no dropping verification/preprocessing costs; no full-round impossibility claim.
